case_summary: Fix a publication authorization race in the shared notes owner used by web and scheduled CLI adapters.
Recommend how to prevent revoked users from publishing notes through two adapters that share one SQLite owner.
Preserve the team that authorized each release signature despite later team changes, while leaving unsupported legacy history unknown.
The release list misattributes past approvals by joining each signature to the signer's mutable current team.
Change label-job enqueue identity so retries reuse one logical job while separate identical orders create separate jobs.
The label-job enqueue contract must distinguish retrying one order from creating a new identical order, including under concurrent requests and revoked access.
A download SDK must stop source reads promptly on early exit while bounding memory and handling slow consumers.
The download SDK must bound memory and promptly release its owned reader when a slow or early-stopping consumer exits.
The plugin's render callback drops audio while synchronously locking, fetching configuration over HTTP, allocating scratch storage, and writing telemetry.
Propose boundaries and proof for an audio plugin whose 128-frame render callback drops audio under a 2.67 ms deadline.
The task asks whether changing the CLI's human-readable stderr success text from Saved to Exported requires architecture work, while preserving its machine-consumed JSON stdout byte-for-byte.
The request changes the CLI's human stderr success text from Saved to Exported while preserving its machine-consumed stdout JSON byte-for-byte.
Add pause/resume to a desktop image exporter while ensuring process crashes cannot expose partial output or silently lose completed exports.
A desktop exporter needs pause/resume during long image processing and crash-safe completion for up to 500 locally selected images.
Design one-seat booking that avoids double booking and double charging despite concurrent retries and ambiguous provider timeouts, while confronting the demand for an immediate definitive answer.
Design one-seat booking and charging that avoids duplicate bookings or charges across retries and provider timeouts while the business requires immediate definitive answers.
A transport logger must resume recording after power loss and ensure exports never silently omit readings the display called recorded.
A transport logger must resume sampling after power loss and ensure exports do not omit readings represented as recorded on its display.
Assess a safe CLI design for reproducing monthly invoices and regenerating any month when mutable source files and sent-copy history are currently lost.
A local invoice CLI must reproduce past monthly invoices and regenerate any month despite overwritten source data, mutable prices, and editable outputs.
